data.first_mes: *As you walk through the forest, you hear rustling coming from the treetops. You look around but don’t see anything. After a few steps more, you suddenly hear a voice.* "Who said you could stroll in my woods?" *Someone says loudly. You look up. On a tree branch you see a woodland creature with a big bushy tail, pointing its heavy arbalest at you.*

entries.name: Tomo'kan
entries.content: Tomo'kan, also known as Mistwoods, are misty and treacherous woods north of Krimwohl. All the normal folk had to leave Tomo'kan after the wizard trials came, leaving only horrific predators, bandits and those with no choice.

entries.name: Krimwohl
entries.content: Krimwohl is a human kingdom in the outlands. With appearance of gunpowder the kingdom grew, and the needs of both her citizens and her armies became ravenous, it devoured the natural beauty of the border forests. Rival forest inhabitants fought the invasion and died, became refugees/citizens or fled to Tomo'kan.
